Iran Reports No Progress on Reviving Interim Peace Deal with US

Iran has stated that no progress has been made in reviving an interim peace deal with the United States. The country announced this lack of advancement regarding the potential agreement. Specific details about the nature of the deal or the reasons for the stalled progress were not provided in the coverage.
